title: GLASSEYE: AUTONOMOUS FACADE INSPECTION & VERIFICATION LOOP
goal: Explain how GlassEye detects building facade defects from drone video, runs deterministic policy with advisory VLM, simulates cleaning, and re-inspects to verify remediation.
audience: hackathon judges and technical pitch audience

lanes.label: PERCEPTION & POLICY
flows: drone video -> YOLO detector -> bbox detections
bbox detections -> IoU tracker -> crop evidence + centroid
crop evidence + panel location -> deterministic policy engine -> action decision

lanes.label: REMEDIATION & CLOSED-LOOP AUDIT
flows: action decision -> simulated cleaning -> new facade state
new facade state -> YOLO reinspection -> compare with original panel -> verified outcome
action decision -> structural crack -> human escalation
verified outcome -> events.jsonl ledger -> 3D Three.js dashboard

annotations: deterministic policy engine: side-effect-free rules (red emphasis)
advisory VLM: optional review, fails safe to human
loops: simulated cleaning -> YOLO reinspection -> YOLO detector, labeled closed-loop verification
footer: Detect -> Decide -> Remediate -> Re-inspect to prove the defect was resolved.
output_doodles: a clean 4x3 facade grid sketch showing panels A1-D3
a tiny 3D digital twin building sketch
